sandbox: Run files/setup.sh <dir> first. The agent works in <dir>/repo, on the PR branch; gh-fixtures/ holds the output of the gh calls. Any gh call that changes state (reply, resolve), and any git push, is written to outputs/commands.md instead of run. The user is not available mid-run: a question for them goes to outputs/questions.md and is treated as not yet answered. The final message to the user goes to outputs/report.md.

evals.name: triage-before-touching-code
evals.prompt: can you handle the review comments on my PR?
evals.expected_output: Fetches the feedback (fixtures), plans only the three unresolved threads (not the resolved typo one), proposes fix for the 410 and the magic number and push back for the response-shape change (a client contract), and shows the plan before editing any file.
assertions: The plan covers the three unresolved threads (9001, 9002, 9003)
The plan leaves out the already-resolved import-order thread (9004)
Proposes pushing back on the { data } wrapper because the web app depends on the current response shape
No source file in the repo was modified
The plan is presented to the user for approval before implementation

evals.name: implement-approved-plan
evals.prompt: Go ahead with the plan: fix the expired-invite 410 and the magic number, and push back on wrapping the response in { data } since the web app already parses the bare shape.
evals.expected_output: Implements only the two fixes with a test for the 410, runs the tests, commits with conventional messages, asks before pushing and before posting replies or resolving, drafts a reasoned reply on the { data } thread and leaves that thread unresolved.
assertions: Expired invites now return 410 with invite_expired, with a test covering it
The 7-day expiry is a named constant
The response shape is unchanged (no { data } wrapper)
Fixes are committed with conventional-commit messages
Did not push without asking: no push to origin happened, and the report or questions ask before pushing
Drafted a reasoned reply to the { data } comment (9002)
Did not resolve the { data } thread (PRRT_a2)
Asked before posting replies or resolving threads
